Zen mode music
--------------
Put your own audio files (mp3, ogg, m4a, wav) in this folder and list them in playlist.json:

  ["first track.mp3", "second track.mp3"]

or with names:

  [{"file": "first track.mp3", "title": "First Track", "artist": "Someone"}]

With an empty list, Zen plays its built-in generative jazz trio instead.
Only add music you have the rights to use.
